_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
the single-object envelope, with author, artist and cover_art relationships
carrying attributes because includes[] asked for them, and language-keyed
title, altTitles, description and tag-name maps.
Why synthetic: PLAN §1.3 and §1.4. The shape is documented fact; the work,
the people and the UUIDs are invented, on a host that cannot resolve.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- description exists in en and pt-br, so the source's language decides
- two authors and one artist, listed in API order
- one author appears twice in the relationship list and must be
- a tag whose name map has no entry in the source language falls back
- status is the site's own vocabulary and must survive normalisation

description.en: A surveyor walks the length of a tower nobody finished.
description.pt-br: Um agrimensor percorre uma torre que ninguém terminou.
